title: Slot operator
description: How the fills bound to one slot compose.

title: Maturity stage
description: How far a component is on the maturity ladder. It decides whether a golden path may include the component.

title: Registry trust
description: Whether a registry source is the reviewed common registry or a local registry that adds to it.

title: Content digest
description: The SHA-256 digest of some content, such as a file, a declaration, a component or the registry.

title: Build identity
description: What a compiler records about its own build, from the Go build metadata.

title: Source revision
description: A full commit ID that names one exact source state.

title: Fill signature
description: A person's signature of one fill's test evidence, made with the SSH or GPG key that signs their commits.

title: Qualification standing
description: Where one fill stands on its way to being qualified.

title: Slot reference
description: The one slot a fill implements: a component and one of its slots.

title: Quality evidence kind
description: Which part of the ga quality bar one piece of evidence shows.

title: Go SDK pin
description: One official Go SDK release, fixed by version and by the digest of its contents.

title: SBOM format
description: The format of one software bill of materials.

title: Signer identity
description: Who made an image signature: a keyless identity that the signing service's certificate states, or a Tekton Chains signer named by its public key.

title: CI provider
description: The CI system that builds and signs a service's images.

title: Pinned pipeline reference
description: A reference to shared pipeline code that cannot move: a reusable workflow at one commit, or a Tekton bundle at one digest.

title: Requirement kind
description: What sort of thing a service needs the environment to supply.
